name: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
summary: Jediga asks you to bring Rimtori's Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning to Valormok. The powerful artifact still rests in the wilds.

sections.title: A Tome in the Wilds
sections.body: Rimtori's tome remains on its pedestal, where its pages may hold secrets. Jediga in Valormok asks you to bring the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning back to her, so the powerful artifact will not be left in the wilds.

faq.q: What does Jediga want me to bring?
faq.answer: Jediga asks you to bring her the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning.
Rimtori's tome still sits atop its pedestal in the wilds.

faq.q: Why does Jediga want the tome?
faq.answer: Jediga does not want a powerful artifact left in the wilds.
The tome is identified as Rimtori's, but no further details about Rimtori are given.

attribution: In-game quest text: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
